import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with | some l => BinarySearchTree.is_node l | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties
  get_val result = get_val (get_left t).get! ∧
  BinarySearchTree.is_node (get_right result).get! ∧
  get_val (get_right result).get! = get_val t
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem zig_eq (v lv : Int) (ll lr r : BinarySearchTree)
    (h : zig_precond (BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r)) :
    zig (BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r) h
      = BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r) := rfl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) :
    zig_postcond t (zig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases t with _ | ⟨v, l, r⟩
  · exact False.elim h_precond.2.1
  · rcases l with _ | ⟨lv, ll, lr⟩
    · exact False.elim h_precond.2.2
    · have hbst : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r) :=
        h_precond.1
      simp only [is_bst] at hbst
      obtain ⟨h1, ⟨h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, h6, h7⟩ := hbst
      have hlv : lv < v := h1 lv (by simp [view])
      rw [zig_eq]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, rfl, trivial, rfl⟩
      · simp only [is_bst]
        refine ⟨h2, h3, ?_, ?_, h5, h6, h7⟩
        · intro x hx
          have hx' : x ∈ view lr ∨ x ∈ view r ∨ x = v := by
            simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
            tauto
          rcases hx' with hx' | hx' | hx'
          · exact h4 x hx'
          · exact lt_trans hlv (h6 x hx')
          · subst hx'; exact hlv
        · intro x hx
          apply h1
          simp only [view, Set.mem_union]
          tauto
      · simp only [view]
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## Analysis

The Zig operation is a single right rotation. Given

```
t = Node v (Node lv ll lr) r
```

the result is

```
result = Node lv ll (Node v lr r)
```

**View preservation.** `view t = ((view ll ∪ view lr ∪ {lv}) ∪ view r) ∪ {v}` and
`view result = (view ll ∪ (view lr ∪ view r ∪ {v})) ∪ {lv}`. These are equal as sets (pure associativity/commutativity of `∪`), provable by `ext` + `tauto`.

**BST invariant.** From `is_bst t` we get:
* `h1 : ∀ x ∈ view (Node lv ll lr), x < v`, hence in particular `lv < v` and `∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v`,
* `h2 : ∀ x ∈ view ll, x < lv`, `h3 : is_bst ll`, `h4 : ∀ x ∈ view lr, x > lv`, `h5 : is_bst lr`,
* `h6 : ∀ x ∈ view r, x > v`, `h7 : is_bst r`.

For `result` we need: left subtree `ll` bounded above by `lv` (that is `h2`, `h3`); everything in `Node v lr r` is `> lv`: elements of `lr` by `h4`, elements of `r` by `lv < v < x`, and `v` itself by `lv < v`; and `Node v lr r` is a BST: `∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v` (from `h1`), `h5`, `h6`, `h7`.

**Structural facts.** `get_val result = some lv = get_val (Node lv ll lr)`, `get_right result = some (Node v lr r)` which is a node with value `v`. All hold by `rfl`/`trivial`.

The impossible cases (`t` empty, or left child empty) are discharged from the precondition, which reduces to `False`.
